observations: The authoritative instruction package remains external and is required to replay full package-manifest validation.
Common.ps1, Verify-Ledger.ps1, and Discover-Toolchain.ps1 intentionally differ from the authoritative intake package after P01 repairs/extensions; their parse and Git whitespace checks pass.
vcpkg.exe has no Windows file-version resource; CLI version output and the exact manifest baseline equals checkout HEAD are recorded instead.
Some successful command stderr files contain only CLIXML host/progress records or Git line-ending warnings; exit codes and stdout/stderr hashes were independently verified.
Pre-validator P01 command records use role architect; all acceptance checks were independently rerun and recorded under role validator.
limitations: This report validates only P00/G00 and P01/G01; it does not claim a product build, feature parity, packaging, runtime behavior, or release readiness.
The repository contained extensive pre-existing unrelated deletions/modifications; validation was scoped to the named P00/P01 files and evidence.
